resource_correlation_probe.interpretation: wall-time variation tracks elapsed cycles/core execution rate more than instruction count or involuntary context switches; supports CPU placement/frequency variability, not a direct proof of migration

writer_scale_probe.interpretation: wall-time CV rises for both implementations only as writers exceed the four performance-core count; process startup alone is not the cause

macos_controls.cpu_affinity: not available via standard process API; Mach affinity tags are experimental L2-sharing hints, not CPU pinning
macos_controls.dtrace: available but root tracing is unavailable without interactive sudo
